author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads the IT Glue activity log from GET /logs. The bridge in bridges/it-glue-activity-logs pulls it and posts each record unchanged to HTTP Ingest. Every record goes to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- IT Glue has no syslog or log export push: workflow webhooks only send a payload you write, from a variable list shown in the app, and take no custom header.
- The activity log is available from GET /logs, so bridges/it-glue-activity-logs pulls it and posts each record unchanged to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration.

Field mapping:
- Every record goes to CloudAudit with the event name resource-type.action (for example Password.update), the user ID, address and user agent.
- Level 1 records, which change no data, are marked read only.
- The record names the user by ID only.

Sources and licenses:
- Fields follow the /logs example in the IT Glue API docs, which only shows a create.

Made up in the samples:
- The docs don't list the action names, so the samples' show action on a level 1 Password record is made up, and so are all values.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (51 of 51 fields matched the emulator).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
